# Every top-level entry of trycua/cua. Checked by .github/scripts/check_root_layout.py
# (bin/ci and the "CI: Root layout" workflow). One name per line; "#" starts a comment.
#
# The root is for what a visitor needs next to the README. A new top-level file
# or folder fails the check unless it is listed here, and listing it needs a
# reason a reviewer accepts. Where things go instead:
#   images, logos, GIFs         .github/assets/
#   scripts and one-off tools   scripts/ (or bin/ for commands people run)
#   docs, blog posts, notes     docs/
#   agent skills and rules      .agents/ (.cursor is a symlink to it)
#   config for one component    inside that component (apps/<app>/ or libs/<lib>/)
#   GitHub config               .github/

# Repo front door
README.md
LICENSE.md
CITATION.cff
AGENTS.md
CLAUDE.md
